description: Vendored contracts, each byte-identical to its source at the pinned commit: C15 (the fact register) from avd-assess, which authors the foundation contracts (avd-second-brain decision 0021). Runbooks cite fact IDs from it (scripts/check_runbooks.py checks the hash and the IDs). To update: copy the file from avd-assess at a new commit, then update the commit and the hash in the same PR.
